content: Individualized medical nutrition therapy is a critical component in the management of type 1 diabetes. It focuses on tailoring dietary strategies to meet the unique needs of each patient. Carbohydrate counting and glycemic control are emphasized, relying on experience-based estimation to help patients manage their blood glucose levels effectively. Education on food composition and insulin dosing is essential, including guidance on meal structure to optimize blood sugar regulation and insulin administration. Regular nutritional assessments with a registered dietitian are strongly recommended to ensure ongoing dietary adjustments and support for optimal diabetes management.
